name: node2-enterprise
description: Node2AI - Self-hosted AI orchestration platform with data sanitization for regulated industries
author: Node2AI

scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @node2/sdk build && pnpm --filter @node2/sanitization build && pnpm --filter @node2ai/licensing build
scripts.build:cloud: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @node2/sdk build && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.build:airgap: pnpm run build:all && pnpm run build:models
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:packages && pnpm run test:apps
scripts.test:packages: pnpm --filter @node2/shared test && pnpm --filter @node2/sdk test && pnpm --filter @node2/sanitization test
scripts.lint:all: pnpm run lint:packages && pnpm run lint:apps
scripts.lint:packages: pnpm --filter @node2/shared lint && pnpm --filter @node2/sdk lint && pnpm --filter @node2/sanitization lint
scripts.clean:all: pnpm --filter @node2/shared clean && pnpm --filter @node2/sdk clean && pnpm --filter @node2/sanitization clean && pnpm --filter @node2/api clean && pnpm --filter @node2/web clean
scripts.type-check:all: pnpm run type-check:packages && pnpm run type-check:apps
scripts.type-check:packages: pnpm --filter @node2/shared type-check && pnpm --filter @node2/sdk type-check && pnpm --filter @node2/sanitization type-check && pnpm --filter @node2ai/licensing type-check
scripts.docker:build:all: pnpm run docker:build:api && pnpm run docker:build:web
scripts.docker:up:prod: cd deployments/docker && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.docker:up:airgap: cd deployments/docker && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.airgap.yml up -d
